# CONCEPT logo motion reference

Source: https://uniplex.jp/wp-content/themes/uniplex/json/bg_logo01.json
Observed: 2026-09-11
SHA-256: 8898b1c5ad2534bfe9da7a40c0f5de38b28b4c8277e69c98ac96160a488f07cd

The source JSON is byte-identical to the live reference. Its original vector artwork spells UNIPLEX. concept-logo-motion.js replaces the composition artwork with MILKY VEIL at runtime: I/L/E outlines and trims are reused; M/K/Y/V use new tapered strokes animated by the original I trim curves. The nine-letter stagger spans the original letter timing range. No redistribution license is asserted.

The existing vendor script owns playback: seven precomposition instances, 24 fps, frames 0–92, non-looping; leaving the hero trigger starts playback, completion hides the stage. The runtime loader changes only background-colored fill/stroke colors to the computed CONCEPT surface. The seven outer layer transforms, row delays, duration and original CSS dimensions remain unchanged. New glyph path geometry differs from the reference.
